records.source_evidence: Medyal tibyofemoral fasetteki 4 mm genişliğinde tam kat fisür eklem dışında kıkırdakları normal.
records.reason: Full-thickness loss establishes depth. The report specifically measures width (genişliğinde) at 4 mm; it does not provide the fissure length or greatest region extent. A narrow full-thickness fissure can extend longitudinally beyond its width. Therefore 4 mm width alone neither establishes >=1 cm extent nor securely excludes it; preserve missing-extent uncertainty rather than inferring a second dimension.

notes: After freezing source-only assessment, personally examined root source assessment, exact proposal and the original reviewed004:18 row. Accept exactly the proposed Medial OA negative-to-uncertain correction. Retain lateral and PF negatives based on normal remaining cartilage. Existing width-based negative confused a measured width with maximum extent. No published annotation, source, rubric or prior assessment was changed.
